title: 测试通过，不等于具备运行能力
coreProposition: Small-scale functional success cannot establish robustness under greater load, parallelism or resource limits.
articleSynopsis: A reproducible agentic Julia study documents functional tests succeeding while larger parallel environments encounter deadlocks, exhaustion, crashes and timeouts. Operational claims require separate load, fault-boundary and reproducibility evidence.
concreteScene: A checked computation module meets a much larger orderly load and shows stress at its supporting boundary.
causalChain: A modest verified module bears increased load, revealing stress not established by its earlier check.
titlePromise: Make the scale difference between passing tests and operating reliably visible.
readerProblem: Promoting local green tests into unrestricted production readiness.
dominantSubject: A cobalt glass processor bearing a stack of load blocks
visibleResult: An amber stress seam develops while its small check remains
authorityScale: Load is visibly substantial; the earlier check is small and subordinate
